## Discovery & Translational Science

- **TFAM loss drives oxaliplatin resistance via mtDNA-mediated lysophagy** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42827098/)
  - Researchers identified that loss of transcription factor A, mitochondrial (TFAM) directly promotes oxaliplatin resistance in cancer models.
  - Mechanistic findings link mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) release to STING-TBK1-mediated lysophagy, highlighting a biological axis for targeting acquired chemoresistance.

- **O-GlcNAc transferase impairment linked to microglial dysfunction and cerebellar hypoplasia** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.26.26363519)
  - Longitudinal human neuroimaging and an `OgtN648Y/y` mouse model identified that pathogenic variants in O-GlcNAc transferase (OGT) disrupt postnatal cerebellar development.
  - Impaired OGT catalytic function blunted IL-4-induced O-GlcNAcylation in primary microglia, altering Purkinje and granule cell densities while promoting inflammatory remodeling.

- **Large-scale sequencing finds no association between rare TMEM106B variants and Parkinson's disease** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.28.26363833)
  - Whole-genome sequencing analysis across 22,010 cases and 40,550 controls from the GP2, AMP-PD, and UK Biobank cohorts evaluated 4,581 unique rare variants in *TMEM106B*.
  - Neither individual rare coding variants nor cumulative gene burden showed a statistically significant association with Parkinson's disease risk.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

- **[Big Pharma]** **Pfizer's tri-specific antibody tilrekimig achieves primary endpoint in Phase 2 eczema trial** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/pfizer-eczema-drug-clears-skin-in-mid-stage-trial/831905/)
  - Tilrekimig demonstrated statistically significant skin clearance (EASI-75) compared to placebo at 16 weeks across multiple dose levels in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis.
  - Based on the mid-stage efficacy and safety profile, Pfizer has advanced the asset into advanced clinical testing across atopic dermatitis (including a head-to-head trial against Dupixent), asthma, and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.

- **[Big Pharma]** **Regeneron presents early phase response data for ubamatamab in MUC16-positive ovarian cancer** [@JacobPlieth](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2106021927483773230)
  - Early clinical findings reported at IGCS 2026 for the MUC16-targeting bispecific antibody ubamatamab showed partial responses in 8 of 11 patients at the 800 mg dose level and 1 of 3 patients at 250 mg.
  - Unconfirmed presentation data highlighted MUC16 expression in low-grade serous ovarian cancer as the primary rationale alongside Regeneron's clinical-stage MUC16×CD28 bispecific REGN5668 and 27T51.

- **Lanreotide evaluated in Phase 2 LAMPARA trial for advanced pheochromocytoma and paraganglioma** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.01.26364504)
  - A prospective, multicenter Phase 2 trial evaluated monthly subcutaneous lanreotide depot (120 mg) in 18 patients with progressive, advanced, or metastatic pheochromocytoma and paraganglioma.
  - The trial assessed antiproliferative activity targeting somatostatin receptors expressed on chromaffin cell-derived neuroendocrine tumors.

- **Sirolimus demonstrates disease control in Phase 2 trial for overgrowth syndromes** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.25.26364046)
  - The single-arm Phase 2 SIPA-SOS trial evaluated oral sirolimus (dosed to target trough levels of 3–8 ng/mL) over 6 months in 18 pediatric and adult patients with PI3K/AKT/mTOR-driven segmental overgrowth with or without vascular malformations.
  - Sixteen patients completed 6 months of therapy, with primary radiological outcomes evaluated by RECIST 1.1 alongside secondary clinical parameters.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

- **[Biotech]** **Kodiak Sciences reports positive late-stage data for Zenkuda in wet AMD** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/week-in-charts-kodiaks-big-comeback-and-hengruis-dealmaking/831690/)
  - Zenkuda met its primary non-inferiority endpoint compared to Regeneron's Eylea in patients with wet age-related macular degeneration when administered at dosing intervals as extended as six months.
  - Efficacy was supported by a diagnostic tool that identified individual patient fluid levels to optimize injection frequency.

- **Recombinant influenza vaccine demonstrates superior relative efficacy in randomized trial** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.01.26364413)
  - A randomized trial (NCT06518577) in 591 adults aged 18–64 evaluated recombinant influenza vaccine (RIV) against cell culture-based inactivated influenza vaccine (ccIIV) during the 2024–2025 season.
  - Active surveillance over six months detected 25 laboratory-confirmed influenza A cases, yielding a cumulative incidence of 2.4% in RIV recipients versus 6.1% in ccIIV recipients.

## Regulatory & Approvals

- **[Big Pharma]** **FDA approves pirtobrutinib for frontline chronic lymphocytic leukemia and small lymphocytic lymphoma** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/resources-information-approved-drugs/fda-approves-pirtobrutinib-previously-untreated-chronic-lymphocytic-leukemia-or-small-lymphocytic)
  - Approved Eli Lilly's non-covalent BTK inhibitor pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca) for adult patients with previously untreated CLL or SLL lacking a chromosome 17p deletion.
  - Approval was supported by the open-label Phase 3 BRUIN CLL-313 trial, where pirtobrutinib demonstrated a statistically significant improvement in progression-free survival over six cycles of bendamustine plus rituximab.

- **[Big Pharma]** **FDA expands belzutifan label to frontline combination regimen in advanced renal cell carcinoma** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/resources-information-approved-drugs/oncology-cancerhematologic-malignancies-approval-notifications)
  - Approved Merck's HIF-2α inhibitor belzutifan (Welireg) in combination with Eisai's lenvatinib (Lenvima) for adult patients with advanced clear cell renal cell carcinoma following prior anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy.

- **[Big Pharma]** **FDA extends BLA review timeline for Novo Nordisk's hemophilia A candidate denecimig** [@BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2106133824761700647)
  - According to unconfirmed reports, the FDA informed Novo Nordisk that the regulatory review for denecimig in hemophilia A has been extended due to ongoing manufacturing facility remediation activities.

- **FDA OPDP issues untitled regulatory letters to five drug manufacturers** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/warning-letters-and-notice-violation-letters-pharmaceutical-companies/untitled-letters)
  - The Office of Prescription Drug Promotion issued untitled letters regarding promotional compliance to Evolus (Jeuveau), Travere Therapeutics (Filspari), Sanofi (Beyfortus), Viatris (Tobi Podhaler), and Alar Pharmaceuticals (ALA-3000).

## Business & Strategy

- **[Biotech]** **Foghorn Therapeutics cuts 40% of workforce following termination of Eli Lilly oncology partnership** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/foghorn-eli-lilly-wave-samsung-bioepis-teva-varda-hatteras/831918/)
  - Foghorn discontinued its lead synthetic lethality candidate FHD-909 and an unannounced SMARCA2 program after failing to reach efficacy thresholds required for further clinical development.
  - Eli Lilly officially terminated its 2021 oncology drug discovery and development collaboration with Foghorn following the program halts.

- **[Big Pharma]** **Eli Lilly bypasses traditional Australian pharmacies with direct-to-consumer Mounjaro distribution** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/02/biotech-news-lilly-bypasses-australian-phramacies-with-dtc-model/)
  - Launched its LillyDirect platform in Australia to ship tirzepatide (Mounjaro) directly to patients' homes, circumventing local retail pharmacy distribution channels.

## Public Health & Policy

- **Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo passes 4,000 amid ongoing violence** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/02/ebola-outbreak-congo-4000-deaths/)
  - Outbreak fatalities have surpassed 4,000 in the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record, with response logistics facing severe setbacks after an active treatment facility was burned down.

- **Study highlights persistent drop-off in youth opioid treatment retention despite initial medication access** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/02/youth-opioid-treatment-retention-study-barriers-to-care/)
  - A new study reveals that while initial prescribing of addiction medications to young patients with opioid use disorder has improved, overall long-term treatment retention rates remain exceptionally low.

- **U.S. government approves 10 pharmaceutical manufacturers for 340B rebate pilot program** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/10/02/340b-drug-pilot-program-boehringer-zealand-obesity-trial/)
  - Approved ten drugmakers to participate in a 340B pilot initiative that shifts eligible provider reimbursement from upfront point-of-sale discounts to a post-purchase rebate model.

**Worth watching:** Pfizer's decision to launch tilrekimig directly into a head-to-head Phase 3 trial against Dupixent sets up a high-stakes clinical showdown in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis.

- Biology & Health
    - [Why Are So Many Investors Cashing Out at the IPO?](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/O2cna8EnxTc) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Examines the high proportion of IPO proceeds going to selling shareholders rather than funding company growth.
        - Analyzes what early exits by venture capitalists and early investors signal to the broader stock market.
        - Features insights from Patrick E. Donohue on capital allocation and liquidity events during initial public offerings.
- Pure Science
    - [03 - Miniature #mathctober](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/_9asuRDhV5w) -- El Jj
        - Presents a method for creating and exploring fractal geometry at home.
        - Demonstrates mathematical construction techniques in a compact, miniature format.
        - Highlights elegant visual approaches to mathematical concepts.
- Economics
    - [Turkey's $20 Billion Fund Collapse Explained](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LF8kY5BLe_o) -- Patrick Boyle
        - Analyzes the collapse of Turkey's investment fund industry, where regulators froze and liquidated 131 funds totaling $20 billion across 455,000 investors following redemption failures by Tera and Pusula.
        - Details how Emre Tezmen's firm, Tera, reported returns exceeding 66,000% by purchasing thinly traded Borsa Istanbul stocks to artificially inflate valuations.
        - Explains how retail money market funds, perceived as safe cash equivalents, were exposed to overvalued equities through reverse repo loans.
        - Compares the structural leverage, market manipulation, and regulatory failure to historical collapses like Bernie Cornfeld's Investors Overseas Services and Bill Hwang's Archegos Capital.
        - Details the resulting arrests, warnings from MSCI, and political fallout from what Turkish authorities labeled "Ponzi-like schemes."
